digest.component_or_area: CloudWatch monitoring alarms and SNS notification
propositions: Two CloudWatch alarms (voter_errors and replication_errors) declare no alarm_actions or ok_actions, so their OK-to-ALARM transitions fire silently with no SNS notification to operators.

An audit of 13 aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm blocks in infra/terraform/ shows 11 wire both alarm_actions and ok_actions to aws_sns_topic.alerts, establishing the repo convention; only these two omit the actions.
The voter_errors alarm's own docstring claims it surfaces a broken voter to an operator, but the resource implements no such notification, violating its documented contract.
A guard test must parse all aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm blocks and fail on any lacking alarm_actions, with an anti-vacuity assertion and mandatory opt-out marker to prevent future silent alarms.
Merging Gerrit change 1430 (HCL wiring) does not apply the changes to AWS; production alarms remain actionless until terraform apply is executed by an operator.
